blocks.tamil_translation: they forbid (others); they establish Salah, give Zakat and obey Allah and His Messenger; such people - Allah will soon have mercy on them - surely Allah is All-Mighty over all things; All-Wise.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَتَعَاوَنُوا عَلَي الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَي ص وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا عَلَي اْلإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Help one another in righteousness and fear of Allah; do not help one another in sin and transgression.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلاً مِمَّنْ دَعَا إِلَي اللهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحاً وَقاَل إِنَّنِي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ۞ وَلَا تَسْتَوِي الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ ؕ اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ ۞ وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا ۚ وَمَا يُلَقّهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Who is better in speech than the one who calls (people) to Allah, does good deeds and says “Surely I am among the Muslims'? Good and evil are not equal; (O Prophet,) repel (evil) with that (good) which is best! Then the one between whom and you there is enmity - surely he will become like a close friend.None will attain this (beautiful quality of removing evil with good) except those who were patient; and none will attain it except one who has great good fortune.
